## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] Added a changeset (`pnpm changeset`) if published behavior changed
- [ ] Ran `pnpm size:update` and committed `size-report.json` if published code or CSS changed
- [ ] Ran `pnpm size:apps:update` and committed `app-size-report.json` if the size apps or their dependencies changed
- [ ] Updated the guides in `packages/docs` if the public API or its behavior changed
